enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Body relaxed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep. Turn to right side. Continue sleeping. Snore lightly. Mouth closed. Hands under pillow. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up in bed. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Enter bathroom. Close door. Turn on light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower lid. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, preparing and eating breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Pick up kettle. Fill kettle with water from tap. Place kettle on base. Press switch to boil. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Pick up banana. Peel banana. Eat banana. Stand up. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in dishwasher. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, packing work bag and lunch, checking phone for the day's schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open work bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch box. Place lunch box in bag. Walk back to bedroom. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open calendar app. Check schedule. Lock phone. Place phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office door. Open door. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit: coordinating community programs, running morning team check-in, answering emails and phone calls
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email application. Read emails. Reply to emails. Pick up phone. Dial number. Speak on phone. Hang up. Stand up. Walk to meeting room. Sit at table. Lead team check-in. Discuss program coordination. Assign tasks. Take notes. Stand up. Walk back to desk. Continue working on computer. Open program planning document. Edit document. Save document. Pick up phone. Answer call. Speak. Hang up. Send email. Attend to other tasks.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office and eating lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from desk. Walk to elevator. Press button. Enter elevator. Press ground floor button. Exit elevator. Walk out of building. Walk to nearby cafe. Enter cafe. Order sandwich. Pay. Receive sandwich. Find table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw away trash. Walk back to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit: program planning, meeting community partners, preparing materials for upcoming events
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Review program plans. Write notes. Make phone calls to partners. Send emails. Print materials. Collate documents. Attend meeting with partners. Discuss event details. Take notes. Return to desk. Update schedule. Prepare materials for upcoming event. Organize folders. Check inventory. Order supplies. Confirm venue. Send confirmation emails. Review budget. Update spreadsheet. File documents. Stand up. Walk to printer. Pick up printouts. Walk back to desk. Staple packets. Place in box. Continue working.

Stand up from desk. Pack laptop in bag. Walk to elevator. Press button. Enter elevator. Press ground floor button. Exit elevator. Walk out of building. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door. Lock door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Place vegetables on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Place pan on induction cooker. Plug in induction cooker. Press power button. Add oil to pan. Add chicken. Stir with spatula. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Stir. Press off button. Unplug induction cooker. Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Place plate on table. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher. Wipe counter.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Browse phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Light reading and browsing phone by the desk lamp, keeping appliance use low during the peak tariff window
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Walk to desk. Sit on chair. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll. Like post. Comment. Lock phone. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bed. Sit on bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading and running the dishwasher now that the off-peak tariff has started, wiping down the counter
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open dishwasher door. Pick up dirty dishes from sink. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher door. Press start button. Pick up cloth. Wet cloth. Wipe counter. Rinse cloth. Wipe counter again. Put cloth away. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum cleaner. Turn on vacuum cleaner. Vacuum floor. Move sofa. Vacuum under sofa. Move sofa back. Vacuum rug. Turn off vacuum cleaner. Unplug vacuum cleaner. Put away vacuum cleaner. Pick up items on coffee table. Place items in drawer. Fluff pillows. Fold blanket. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash, showering and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Enter bathroom. Close door. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Place clothes in hamper. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Body relaxed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep. Turn to right side. Continue sleeping. Snore lightly. Mouth closed. Hands under pillow. Remain still.
